title: Lmed tamusni-k
lede: Sedis isental, mraw isteqsiyen i yal yiwen: seg welim n tfunast n Elisa ar igennaḏ n Qarṭaǧ. Yal tiririt tezwar ɣer usebter n usmel anida ara t-teɣreḍ.
heroAlt: Hanibal ilemẓi yeggul, afus-is ɣef umqam, ur yettuɣal ara d amdakel n Ṛuma
pickAside: Isteqsiyen d tririyin ttuɣelɣelent di yal tirart. Afran-ik ameqqran yeqqim di yinaw-agi n unadi.
storageNote: Ifranen imeqqranen ttwaseklasen ala di tɛeddawt-agi; ulac acemma yettwazenen.
keysHint: Taxidant n tiqeffalin: isegman i umussu, tiqeffalin 1 ar 4 i tririt.
messages.0: Qarṭaǧ ur tebni ara di yiwen wass: ɛerred tasebtiyin-agi sdat-ek, uɛawed tirart.
messages.1: Abdu yelhan! Kra n isebtar ara tɛeǧǧebeḏ, tirart i d-iteddun ad tili tifrat.
messages.2: Lhant! Tessneḏ yakan amaḏal apunik mliḥ.
messages.3: Mučaɛ! Ula Bulib ad k-id-yerr d aɣbalu.
messages.4: Ulac ccbaḥa ɣer tagara! Hanibal ur yezmir ara ad yexdem ugar.
recapPerfectText: Akk tririyin-ik ṣeḥḥit. Ɛreḍ asentel nniḍen i tfakkeḏ tirzi-k ɣer Qarṭaǧ.
more.0.d: Sebɛa iqeṛnan n umezruy apunik, lawan s lawan.
more.1.d: Elisa, Ibarkiyen, inagmaren akked igelliden inumidiyen.
more.2.d: Sufeṭ, tofet, Kuṭun, šikel: awalen n umaḏal apunik.
metaDesc: Sețțin isteqsiyen deg sedis isental ɣef Qarṭaǧ: asers, Hanibal d imenɣan ipunikiyen, addin, tadamsa, udmawen akked Tunes n wass-agi.
